matches.tactical_summary: Argentina dominated possession and tempo in the first half, establishing a comfortable lead through early goals. Jordan's halftime adjustments led to a more spirited second-half performance and a consolation goal, but Argentina ultimately sealed the win with a late strike.

narrative: Defending champions Argentina secured their passage to the Round of 16 with a 3-1 victory over tournament debutants Jordan, showcasing their depth even with squad rotation. Lionel Messi's late free-kick was a highlight, as Jordan fought valiantly to score a historic goal in their World Cup journey.
next_round_notes: Argentina will continue to manage the fitness of key players, including Cristian Romero (knee injury, expected to return to full training) and Lionel Messi (muscle fatigue and hamstring strain), as they prepare for the demanding Round of 16.
